dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Represents a bookmark dashboard tab or sheet.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this dashboard.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this dashboard was created.

category.title: Category
category.description: A container (or column box) for bookmarks inside a dashboard tab.

order.description: Sorting order within the dashboard or column.

column.description: The flex column index (e.g. 0, 1, 2) in which the category is placed.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this category.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this category was created.

tags.description: List of tags associated with this bookmark.

dashboardId.description: ID of the parent dashboard containing the category.

order.description: Sorting order of the bookmark within its category.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this bookmark.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this bookmark was created.

dashboards/{dashboardId}.description: Dashboards which form the primary tabs.

categories/{categoryId}.description: Categories grouping bookmarks in a dashboard.
